sn24.18:1.2: kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave, sati kiṃ upādāya kiṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati :
sn24.18:2.1: rūpe kho bhikkhave, sati rūpaṃ upādāya rūpaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati :
sn24.18:2.2: neva hoti na nahoti tathāgato parammaraṇā”ti. vedanāya sati …pe… saññāya sati …pe… saṅkhāresu sati …pe… viññāṇe sati viññāṇaṃ upādāya viññāṇaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati : “neva hoti na nahoti tathāgato parammaraṇā”ti.
sn24.18:3.4: viparināmadhammaṃ, api nu taṃ anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya :
sn24.18:3.6: no hetaṃ bhante. vedanā …pe… saññā …pe… saṅkhārā …pe… viññāṇaṃ …pe…
sn24.18:3.7: yampidaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā, tampi niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vāti?
sn24.18:3.9: yampanāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā’ti?
sn24.18:3.11: yampanāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ viparināmadhammaṃ api nu taṃ anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya :
sn24.18:4.1: yato kho bhikkhave, ariyasāvakassa imesu chasu ṭhānesu kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti, dukkhe’pissa kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti, dukkhasamudaye’pissa kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti, dukkhanirodhe’pissa kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti, dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya’pissa kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti.
sn24.18:4.2: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, ariyasāvako sotāpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyanoti.
sn24.18:5.2: so attā no ca me siyā
sn24.18:6.3: anantavā ca taṃ vuttaṃ taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti
sn24.18:7.3: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti.
